text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Vietnamese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Vietnam and Israel will sign an agreement to enhance agricultural cooperation during the coming visit by Israeli Deputy Prime Minister Rafael Eitan.
-- The State Bank of Vietnam says the World Bank will loan Vietnam $617 million during the 1997-1998 fiscal year.
-- Cambodia's Parliament President Chea Sim has told Vietnam's ambassador in Phnom Penh that Cambodia wishes to strengthen the relations of friendship and cooperation with Hanoi.
-- Foreign-invested businesses will have to use a bank account in Vietnam for their cash transactions from July 13, according to a decision by the State Bank of Vietnam.
-- Foreign investment in sectors under management of the Ministry of Industry in the first seven months of 1997 has decreased by 50 percent compared with the same period last year.
-- Hanoi has raised the second level alarm over water levels in the city's rivers.
-- Foreign Minister Nguyen Manh Cam says Vietnam has made a big step forward in the way to integrate into ASEAN.
